findings.detail: Performs COMMIT community-dependent gap filling across member models but does not merge conflicting drafts into a single nonredundant consensus model.
Aggregates microbial boundary-metabolite fluxes for setting host exchange bounds, covering the extracellular-flux constraint portion of the multi-omics stage.
Computes FVA reaction bounds and directionality classes but does not normalize and statistically compare the sampled distributions.
Runs community FBA to produce exchange and dependency analyses rather than consolidating sampled and interpreted flux results with the community model.
Runs upstream sampling and Mann-Whitney classification to emit FFD files rather than assembling interpreted flux states with the consensus community model into one report.
Runs an upstream metabolomics-based flux-prediction operation and emits RPS classes rather than assembling the requested combined flux-state report.
